name: stage_1_stand_symmetric
description: E1b observe v3 (Joseph UI findings 2026-06-10, corrected).  Stand-only with: (1) leg_symmetry_fr_blend=0.5 — front-rear posture coupling that collapses the seed-random asymmetric sit (the sit is what appears when this pairing is absent — it is the real sit-fix); (2) target_height=0.09 — a MODEST up-target (just above the 0.085 the sit settles at).  NOTE: an earlier draft used target_height=1.0; that was a live 'kick' to escape an already-formed sit, but as a tabula-rasa learning target it over-drives the climb and roughly doubles falls — so the curriculum uses 0.09 + the pairing (which does the actual fixing).  (3) advance at best_cumulative_alive_ticks>=4000 (~80 s) — the 20 s/1200-tick trigger fired before the stance stabilised.  Requires the F9_W1_diag_walk config (leg_symmetry=lr_pairs).

name: stage_2_ready_stand
description: After a stable symmetric stance is reached (~80 s), settle target_height to 0.085 while keeping the front-rear blend.  Still stand-only (no walking reward yet) — this is the gait-ready symmetric base the rhythm/coordination layer will build on.
